title: Liz Earle set £39, Ninja Double Stack XL £179.99 and Dyson V8 at its lowest Argos price
description: Sunday's UK deals: a half-price Liz Earle skincare set, the Ninja Double Stack XL down to £179.99 and the Dyson V8 Cyclone at Argos's lowest price.
intro:
**Sunday's best buy for gift shoppers is the Liz Earle Superskin Collection at £39 on Lookfantastic, half its £78 price for one week only.** Beauty gifts and fragrance lead again, with a 30% cut on Estée Lauder at John Lewis and big bottles of Givenchy and Versace well under their usual prices. For the home, Argos has the Ninja Double Stack XL down to £179.99 and the Dyson V8 Cyclone at the lowest price it has ever charged.

Every price was checked on the retailer's own page today (8 November) or in a report from 7 November. Buy now or wait? The beauty sets and perfumes are already at prices that rarely improve, and the best gift sets sell out before Black Friday on 27 November. The Ninja and the pressure washer could drop a little further, but both are fair buys today.

deals.name: Liz Earle Superskin Collection gift set
deals.note: Cleanse & Polish, the Superskin serum and moisturiser plus two cloths, at half price for one week. A thoughtful present for anyone with dry or more mature skin.

deals.name: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Skincare Gift Set
deals.note: Built around Estée Lauder's best-known serum, with 30% off in John Lewis's Black Friday event. For a smaller budget, the ANR Discovery Set is £26.60 (was £38).

deals.name: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude eau de parfum 50ml
deals.note: A warmer, vanilla take on one of the UK's best-selling women's perfumes, at half price as a Boots Star Gift. Stock may be patchy, so don't hang about. More in our [perfume gift set guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

deals.name: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge 80ml
deals.note: A big 80ml bottle for £62.50. We'd ignore the £125 RRP; the fairer comparison is about £69 at the next-cheapest shop, so this still saves a few pounds on the best price elsewhere.

deals.name: Versace L'Homme eau de toilette 100ml
deals.note: A fresh, classic men's scent in the large bottle for under £40. An easy gift; see our [Christmas gifts for him under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-him-under-50/) for more.

deals.name: BaByliss Titanium Shine Professional Hair Straightener
deals.note: Floating plates, a digital display up to 230°C and a heat mat in the box. Lookfantastic says it's half price today only, but its £100 RRP looks high, so treat £50 as a fair price rather than a steal.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Cyclone Cordless Vacuum (2026)
deals.note: Argos says this is the lowest price it has ever charged for the V8 Cyclone, which runs for up to an hour and comes with pet and mattress tools. Our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the prices to watch on bigger models.

deals.name: Ninja Double Stack XL Air Fryer 9.5L (SL400UK)
deals.note: Two drawers stacked on top of each other, so it cooks for a family without taking up the whole worktop. It was about £209 recently, so this is a fresh drop. Compare it in our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Kärcher K4 Classic Home Pressure Washer 1800W
deals.note: The mid-range K4 with enough power for patios, cars and fences, and a home kit for paving. A good price, though we couldn't confirm it's the lowest it has been.

deals.name: LEGO Disney Pixar WALL-E and EVE (43279)
deals.note: A display build that suits older kids and adult fans, at a third off. See our [LEGO Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) for more sets worth buying now.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Most of today's beauty picks are prices worth taking now. Gift sets in particular are made in fixed numbers for Christmas, and the popular ones tend to sell out in the run-up to Black Friday rather than get cheaper. Our [Christmas beauty gift sets spotlight](/spotlight/christmas-beauty-gift-sets-2026/) has the target prices for this season's big-name sets.

The Ninja Double Stack XL and the Kärcher pressure washer could fall a little more by 27 November. If you'd rather wait, our [Black Friday guides](/black-friday/) list the prices worth holding out for.

Cold nights ahead? Our new [electric blanket deals guide](/guides/electric-blanket-deals-uk/) works out what they cost to run, with a double costing under 2p an hour on full power.
